title: Trump FCC declares California isn't allowed to enforce phone service rules
summary: FCC preempts state rules that require AT&T to keep offering home phone service.
llm_summary: The Federal Communications Commission, under the Trump administration, ruled that California cannot enforce a state regulation that would force AT&T to keep providing traditional home‑phone (landline) service to customers. By preempting the state rule, the FCC says that such service obligations are a matter of federal, not state, jurisdiction. This decision
